units.source_text: 俊德九双目失明，在黑暗中看到了夕阳的影子也起舞的难波海。

en.t: Shuntoku Kyu had lost sight in both eyes, yet in the darkness he saw the sea of Naniwa, where even the shadows of the setting sun seemed to dance.

units.source_text: 天气晴朗时，甚至还看到了夕阳映照的淡路绘岛、须磨明石、纪之海……

en.t: When the weather was clear, he could even see Awaji Eshima, Suma Akashi, and the Sea of Kii, all lit by the setting sun...
